steps.note: 同 xueqiu-quote：这跳导航就是 cookie 预热

args.script: (async () => { const g = async (u) => { const r = await fetch(u, { credentials: 'include' }); return { r, j: await r.json() } }; const hs = await g('https://stock.xueqiu.com/v5/stock/hot_stock/list.json?size={{size}}&type=10'); const hot_stocks = (((hs.j.data || {}).items) || []).map((x, i) => ({ rank: i + 1, symbol: x.code || x.symbol, name: x.name, current: x.current, percent: x.percent })); const hp = await g('https://www.xueqiu.com/v4/statuses/public_timeline_by_category.json?since_id=-1&max_id=-1&count={{posts}}&category=-1'); const strip = (s) => (s || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const hot_posts = ((hp.j.list) || []).map(it => { try { const d = JSON.parse(it.data); return { id: d.id, title: d.title || '', author: (d.user || {}).screen_name || '', text: strip(d.text || d.description).slice(0, 200), likes: d.like_count || 0, url: d.target ? ('https://xueqiu.com' + d.target) : '' }; } catch (e) { return null; } }).filter(Boolean); if (!hot_stocks.length && !hot_posts.length) throw new Error('xueqiu trending empty — stocks http=' + hs.r.status + ' posts http=' + hp.r.status); return { hot_stocks: hot_stocks, hot_posts: hot_posts }; })()

steps.note: 两个端点一次 eval 串行拿：热股榜 stock.xueqiu.com（跨子域 CORS 面 OK）+ 热帖 v4 公共时间线（必须 www.xueqiu.com——裸 xueqiu.com 会 301 到 www，重定向响应的 ACAO 是空串，浏览器上下文直接被拦；他们的 Python 版没有 CORS 概念才走得通）。热帖每条 data 字段是 JSON 字符串要二次 parse，text 是带标签 HTML 要剥
